newsitem.title: BELARUS: CIS summit "will not take place"-secretariat.
newsitem.headline: CIS summit "will not take place"-secretariat.

text.p: A summit meeting of leaders of the Commonwealth of Independent States, planned for January 29, will not take place, the CIS secretariat in the Belarussian capital Minsk said on Friday.
"The summit will not take place," a press spokesman said. He said further information would be available shortly.
The press service said the meeting, already postponed once, had been put back to another date.
A spokesman said the presidents of Belarus, Ukraine, Kazakhstan and Kyrgyzstan had asked Russian President Boris Yeltsin to postpone the meeting, which had been due to take place in Moscow.
"B. Yeltsin supported the suggestion of postponing the meeting," he added.
Yeltsin, 65, has been away from the Kremlin for most of the last seven months, first with heart problems and then with pneumonia. He underwent a heart bypass operation on November 5.
